rows.claim: the docstring names ArgumentInvalid for the claim and range refusals but not their reasons :claimed and :range
rows.evidence: design/rules/docstring_rules.md rule 21; Appendix B spec.md:15103,15117; probe:24,30
rows.fix: Name the reasons: "A model claimed by a Simulation is refused as ArgumentInvalid with reason :claimed, and so is a k past the last frame, with reason :range."

rows.claim: code_map's frame.jl entry omits _trial!, the trial evaluation that _crossing calls (the ITP and arrival machinery around it is listed)
rows.fix: Add to the _localized_step! bullet: "`_crossing` runs each trial through `_trial!`, which writes x(theta) by `dense!`, sets the mid-step clock, runs the interior sweep and evaluates the guards."

rows.claim: header says model.jl's integrate_step! raises the discontinuity notice, but its body never calls discontinuity!; the notice is raised by run_boundary!, overlay! and the frame top
rows.fix: Replace "writes the clock, and raises the notice" with "and writes the clock. The notice is raised by `run_boundary!`, `overlay!` and the frame top (model.jl, frame.jl)."

rows.claim: code_map's stepper.jl entry never names AbstractStepper, the abstract type every stepper and the seam's generic dense! dispatch on
rows.fix: Add to the entry: "`AbstractStepper`, the abstract type of the steppers; the generic `dense!` and the `discontinuity!` default dispatch on it."

rows.claim: ExecutionCursor says it is overwritten by one store per dispatch and one per phase transition and read only at the catch site; it also takes a store per RHS evaluation (index += 1), a store of the attempt ordinal, and a read in the stage counter
rows.fix: Say: "overwritten by one cheap store per user-code dispatch and per phase transition, and bumped per RHS evaluation and per attempt; read at the catch site (`_wrap_step`, model.jl)."

rows.claim: EventSet says triggered is the frame's triggered set, but the frame loop rewrites it for every localization segment (and the validation prunes it), so it is the current segment's set
rows.fix: Say: "`triggered` is the current localization segment's triggered set".

rows.claim: code_map's executor.jl entry omits _store_successor!, the runtime check that raises ConformanceFailure for a wrong s_update return
rows.fix: Add a bullet: "`_store_successor!`, the write of an `s_update` return, which refuses a value not of the store's own type as `ConformanceFailure` (§9.5, D-235)."

rows.claim: the runtime s_update check labels a named store whose returned NamedTuple has the same field names but a wrong value type as reason :field_set with no field; Appendix C says the reason names the failed clause (:field_type with the field's expected and observed types)
rows.fix: In _store_successor!, give reason :field_type with the first mismatching field when the field names match, and :field_set only when the names differ.

rows.claim: code_map's executor.jl entry omits _event_bodies and _project_body, which build the per-event guard and handler callables and the per-component projection callables that phase_bodies returns
rows.fix: Add a bullet: "`_event_bodies` and `_project_body`, the measurement seam's callables for one event's guard and handler and one projection, closed over the entry and the buffers (§9.7); `phase_bodies` returns them keyed by the model's roster."
